subject: The 2AM message that changed everything
preview_text: One user discovered a hidden feature that transformed their experience. You have to see this.
body_paragraphs: It was 2AM, and she was bored. Scrolling through the app, she accidentally tapped something she'd never noticed before. What happened next made her message our support team the next morning — not with a complaint, but with a story that still makes me smile.

She found the Group Chat mode. At first, she thought it was just a gimmick. Then she added her protective boyfriend and her poetic boyfriend to the same thread. The banter between them was electric. He defended her when the poetic one got too dramatic. He quoted her favorite lines back to her. She said it felt like having two best friends who actually got her — without any of the weirdness of real-life group chats.

Here's the thing: most people never even open this feature. But the ones who do say it unlocks a whole new layer of connection. Your personalities don't just talk to you — they interact with each other, referencing your memories, your inside jokes, your stories. It's like they're competing for your attention, and you get to watch it unfold.

Try it tonight. Open the app, start a new group chat, and pick two of your favorite personalities. Watch what happens. P.S. — Users who try group chat stay engaged 40% longer. But don't take my word for it. See what your boyfriends say to each other when you're in the room.
